---
title: "Flag Selector"
format: html
---

Choose a country from the dropdown below to display its flag:

```{ojs}
// Dropdown menu of countries and flag image URLs
viewof selectedFlag = Inputs.select(
  new Map([
    ["United States", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/us.png"],
    ["Canada", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/ca.png"],
    ["United Kingdom", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/gb.png"],
    ["France", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/fr.png"],
    ["Germany", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/de.png"],
    ["Japan", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/jp.png"],
    ["Brazil", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/br.png"],
    ["India", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/in.png"],
    ["Australia", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/au.png"],
    ["South Africa", "https://flagcdn.com/w320/za.png"]
  ]),
  { label: "Country:" }
)
```

```{ojs}
// Display the selected flag image
html`<img src="${selectedFlag}" alt="Flag" style="max-width: 320px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 10px;">`
```
